D: A mild radio exec tries to win over his stepkids when their cool, motorbike-riding real dad comes home.
P: Serve the mains when Brad and Dusty go head to head.
S: Brad doing everything by the parenting book
A neat platter of carrot, cucumber and capsicum sticks with hummus, the responsible stepdad snack.
Loaded corn chips with beef, cheese, salsa and sour cream, the cool dad's party move.
M: the two dads at the grill
Big beef burgers with cheese, lettuce, tomato and onion, built in a backyard showdown. Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and sprinkles, for the night of the dance. Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk.
K: Homemade lemonade with mint over ice, as smooth as the station Brad runs.

s.note: Brad doing everything by the parenting book
s.how: Cut 2 carrots, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks and arrange on a platter around 250g hummus. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Brown 400g beef mince with taco seasoning. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, top with the beef and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Finish with salsa and 150g sour cream.

m.note: the two dads at the grill
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties. Grill 4 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end. Build in 4 toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, onion and sauce.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Top with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and a drop of pink colouring.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 6 lemons and 1L cold water, add mint and serve over ice.
